name: Heeding the Call

angles.text: As a druid, you leave basic novice training and begin learning nature's deeper forms under Archdruid Staghelm's direct assistant.
At the heart of Darnassus, the Cenarion Enclave shows how deeply Cenarion druidism is woven into Kaldorei society.
As a member of the Alliance, you join night elf druids answering the Cenarion call in Darnassus. Their work strengthens the Alliance's ancient magical and natural foundations on Kalimdor.

aliases: who wants to talk to me
faq.answer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker is a wise druid and the direct assistant to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm. He oversees advanced instruction for promising druids in Darnassus.
Mathrengyl Bearwalker is on the second floor of Fandral Staghelm's tree in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. Senior members of the Cenarion Circle convene there on Teldrassil.
Your basic training is complete, and your path as a druid is ready to widen. Mathrengyl will guide you into nature's deeper disciplines.
faq.q: Why was I summoned to speak with Mathrengyl?

faq.answer: Mathrengyl begins teaching you the ways of the bear. You learn strength of body and heart to help protect nature's balance.
faq.q: What will I learn from Mathrengyl Bearwalker?

faq.answer: Cenarius is the patron demigod of nature and teacher of the first druids. His followers believe all druids share a duty to protect Azeroth's wild plants and beasts.
faq.q: What does it mean to be among 'Cenarius' children'?

faq.answer: Fandral Staghelm's tree is a grand, hollow living tree in Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave. Archdruid Fandral Staghelm and his inner circle direct Cenarion affairs across Teldrassil from there.

sections.body: As your basic instruction among Teldrassil's boughs comes to an end, word arrives that Mathrengyl Bearwalker wishes to speak with you. He is the direct assistant to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm and one of the Cenarion Enclave's wisest elders. His summons calls you beyond basic wardenship and toward the deeper arts of nature.
sections.title: A Summons to Darnassus

sections.body: You travel to the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus and climb to the second floor of Archdruid Staghelm's great tree. Bearwalker welcomes you and reminds you that those who answer Cenarius' call must honor plants and beasts as companions and charges. To preserve nature's balance, you need more than quiet reflection. You must learn the ways of the wild bear and master strength of body and heart.
sections.title: The Path of the Bear

summary: Mathrengyl Bearwalker calls a young night elf druid to Darnassus to continue their training. As Archdruid Fandral Staghelm's direct assistant, he prepares the initiate for the trials of the bear.
attribution: In-game quest text: Heeding the Call
